In a merger under § 13.1-1099.16, the articles of merger shall:
Comply with § 13.1-1072 and include a plan of merger that complies with the provisions of § 13.1-1099.17;
Be accompanied by the following records, each to become effective when the merger becomes effective: a. For a protected series of a merging company being canceled as a result of the merger, a statement of designation cancellation; b. For a protected series of a non-surviving company which after the merger will be a relocated protected series:
A statement of relocation that contains the name of the non-surviving company and the name of the protected series before and after the merger; and
A statement of protected series designation; and c. For a protected series being established by the surviving company as a result of the merger, a statement of protected series designation; and
A statement presented with articles of merger pursuant to this section may be filed with the Commission without payment of the fee specified in § 13.1-1005.
